subject: Insurance
title: The Christchurch Earthquakes
description: Learn The Christchurch Earthquakes in one minute.

hook.text: New Zealand's 2010-2011 Christchurch earthquakes caused $31 billion in losses—in a country with only 5 million people.

buildup.text: The first quake in September 2010 damaged buildings.

discovery.text: New Zealand's Earthquake Commission (EQC) covered the first layer of damage. Private insurers covered the rest.

twist.text: EQC was overwhelmed. Over 460,000 claims—more than one per household in the region. Processing took years.

climax.text: Christchurch tested the limits of a small nation's insurance system.

quiz.question: What challenge did New Zealand face after the Christchurch earthquakes?
options: The claims volume overwhelmed the national system
